summary.text: Clay Faircloth is an independent candidate for Tennessee's 4th District. Ballotpedia lists his profession as pastor and social worker, and in a 2024 Candidate Connection survey he described himself as a counselor, pastor and community engagement influencer; he previously sought the Democratic nomination in the 6th District in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Clay Faircloth graduated from McGavock High School and earned a graduate degree from Trevecca Nazarene University in 2013.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as pastor, work at a Nissan plant, and career coaching with Metro Nashville, and lists his profession as pastor and social worker.
In his 2024 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a counselor, pastor and community engagement influencer.
Faircloth appeared on the Democratic primary ballot for Tennessee's 6th District in 2022 and 2024, losing to Randal Cooper and Lore Bergman respectively.
In 2026 he is running as an independent in the 4th District.
